meta.title: 为什么你修的粉调婚纱照又脏又廉价？
meta.title_en: Why Your Pink Wedding Photos Look Cheap

scenes.context: 客户想要粉调的婚纱照，我们第一反应是不是直接给他加粉色？这样只会又闷又脏。
sentences: The instinct is to add pink.
paraphrase: The instinct is to add pink.
scenes.speak: The instinct is to add pink. That only makes it muddy.

scenes.context: 客户想要的不是单纯的粉色，而是整体柔和的粉色调。
sentences: What they want is a soft pink tone.
paraphrase: What they want is a soft pink tone.
scenes.speak: What they want is a soft pink tone. Not just pouring on pink.

scenes.context: 第一步把画面调通透，选择曲线先调光感，将红绿蓝三个通道的高光提起来。
sentences: Lift highlights in all three channels.
paraphrase: Lift highlights in all three channels.
scenes.speak: First adjust the light. Lift highlights in all three channels.

scenes.context: 三色混合就通透很多，再加一点亮度，接着用曲线柔光模式做一个曲灰效果。
scenes.speak: Soft-light mode creates the matte. Lower the opacity.

scenes.context: 画面里的黄跟绿显得杂乱，用可选颜色选黄通道减黄色，绿通道也减黄色。
sentences: Yellow and green clutter the shot.
paraphrase: Yellow and green clutter the shot.
scenes.speak: Yellow and green clutter the shot. Cutting yellow cleans it up.

scenes.context: 关键一步：选取高光，用颜色和自然饱和度工具加点粉色，再减一点色温。
scenes.speak: Add pink in the highlights. Lowering temperature cleans it.

scenes.context: 给照片加一点柔，用曲线提亮一点点，粉调才干净不廉价。
sentences: 粉色婚纱照核心是通透。
The core is clarity, not pink.
paraphrase: The core is clarity, not pink.
scenes.speak: Softening smooths the image. The core is clarity, not pink.

scenes.context: 前后对比一目了然：左侧偏闷偏脏，右侧通透、统一、柔和粉调。
sentences: The left is muddy, the right clean.
Clear and unified is the pink tone.
paraphrase: 用before and after换一种说法
The left is muddy, the right clean.
Clear and unified is the pink tone.
scenes.speak: The left is muddy, the right clean. Clear and unified is the pink tone.

practice: The instinct is to add pink.
What they want is a soft pink tone.
Lift highlights in all three channels.
Yellow and green clutter the shot.
The core is clarity, not pink.
The left is muddy, the right clean.
Clear and unified is the pink tone.
pitfalls: 想要粉调就直接加粉色
直接加粉只会又闷又脏
三通道高光一起提才通透
RGB高光同时提，光感才均匀
可选颜色减黄绿再上色
黄绿杂乱会让粉调显得脏
shifts: 分层处理：光感→曲灰→减杂色→加粉
difficult_words: 曲灰，低对比的柔和质感
可选颜色，定向调整某通道颜色
不透明度，控制图层效果强度
